schemaOutput.note: format accepts "json" or a JSON schema, and response_format on /v1; the page says nothing about format together with tools; not offered on Ollama cloud

serverParses.note: Calls are parsed through the model's Jinja template: pass --jinja (default in newer builds). A template with no matching handler falls to a generic format the docs call less efficient and less reliable.

toolChoice.note: auto uses a lazy grammar that engages only once the model starts a call in its own marker, so a call written in another form is not constrained; required forces a call by grammar. Read as a summary; caveats in the grammar-vs-recovery report. Named-tool choice not read.

toolForceThinking.note: Second-hand: the report says the generated parser embeds reasoning markup so a thinking model can reason, then call. Not read on the primary page.

schemaOutput.note: response_format and json_schema are converted to a grammar; unsupported schema features are skipped silently (grammars README)

grammar.note: grammar field on /completion and /v1/chat/completions; GBNF, see https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/master/grammars/README.md

serverParses.note: Auto tool choice needs --enable-auto-tool-choice and a --tool-call-parser matched to the family; without a parser, required and named requests return 400.

toolChoice.note: required and named use constrained (structured-output) decoding; auto parses raw text, so malformed arguments can occur.

reasoningField.note: Second-hand: the field was reasoning_content in earlier releases and is now reasoning; check the server's version.

schemaOutput.note: response_format json_schema or extra_body structured_outputs; backends xgrammar or guidance

grammar.note: structured_outputs grammar, regex and choice kinds; guided_* fields were removed in v0.12.0

toolForce.note: named and required tool choice are constrained with structured outputs and need a tool parser; "a validly-parsable function call, not a high-quality one"; official-format Mistral models are excepted

toolsHonoured.note: Each upstream endpoint lists its own supported_parameters (live at /api/v1/models/{id}/endpoints); provider.require_parameters decides whether an unsupported parameter is ignored or the route refused.
